narrative.details:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
narrative.objectives: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
narrative.offerRewardText: Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!"all the time?I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
narrative.requestItemsText: What can I do for ya, friend?
